name: yaw
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 车辆或轮对绕竖直轴的转动。
usage_note: 该文把六类运动依次记为x、y、z、ψ、φ、β；符号与其他论文的约定需逐篇核对。

complete_examples.text: The vehicle is modeled as multi-rigid-body includes one car body, two bogies and four wheelsets, and each rigid body has six degrees of freedom (DOFs), i.e., longitudinal-, lateral-, vertical-, yaw-, rolling- and pitch-motion, denoted by x, y, z, ψ, φ and β.
